name: Jeffrey Pine & Rock Slab
desc: Try smelling the jeffry pines ,while being surrounded by cairns and rocks depicting scenary of another planet! Don't you feel the sweet scent of butterscotch?

name: Yosemite Valley
desc: A famous glacier-carved canyon located in the heart of Yosemite, where park reveals its most iconic landscape.

name: Half Dome
desc: Rising 8,800 feet above sea level, Half Dome is a true icon of Yosemite. Look at the amazing shape of this granite dome, literally 'cut in half'.

name: El Capitan
desc: This iconic granite formation, is a small universe of Yosemite. At night, climbers headlamps are the stars, and El Capitan shines like the moon.

name: The Fallen Jeffrey Pine
desc: Immortalized by Ansel Adams and countless others, its bleached wood remains as an amazing meditation on the passage of time!

name: Yosemite Falls
desc: This is true diamond in Yosemite Valley -- the tallest waterfall in entire North America rising 2,425 feet.
